title: TemplateDefinition
description: A Hermes template version. Storage sources and admin settings are checked by the manager against installation settings; this schema covers the shape.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this definition format.

image.description: The Hermes image every instance of this version runs, pinned by digest. A tag is not accepted.
image.x-constraint: Pinned by digest: registry/name@sha256:<64 hex digits>.

resources.description: What each Hermes instance of this version may use.

cpuMillis.description: CPU limit in millicores: 1000 is one core.

home.description: The private Hermes home at /opt/data. Always a dynamic volume; never mounted in a terminal backend.

source.description: The storage source the home is created on. It must be a storage class, a source that provisions volumes on demand.

sizeGib.description: Size of each user's home in GiB. A later version may grow it, but shrinking it or moving it to another source needs an explicit storage migration.

mounts.description: Volumes mounted into Hermes, by volume name.

defaultVolumes.description: Volumes created for assignments that do not define them. Every name must be mounted.

adminConfig.description: Hermes settings (config.yaml keys) enforced over the user's own, kept as given. Never secret values: deliver them under secrets and refer to them as ${NAME}.

secrets.description: Admin secrets delivered to every instance of this version, each as an environment variable or a read-only file.

name.x-constraint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter.

mount.description: One volume as Hermes sees it. The key is the volume's name; an assignment, or defaultVolumes, says where the volume comes from.

mountPath.description: Absolute path where the volume appears in Hermes. It must not overlap another mount or a path the platform reserves.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume read-only in Hermes.

volume.description: One volume an assignment gets unless it defines its own. The key is the volume's name and must also appear under mounts.

source.description: The storage source the volume comes from. A storage class creates a volume of sizeGib; a static source (a local path or an NFS export) needs a path.

path.description: Static sources only: the folder under the source's root, relative and without '..' segments.
path.x-constraint: A relative path, not starting with /.

sizeGib.description: Storage classes only: the size of the volume in GiB.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume read-only everywhere it appears.

secretReference.description: One admin secret delivered to the instance, as an environment variable (env) or a read-only file (file).

name.description: The admin secret to deliver. It must exist, with a kind that fits the delivery, when the version is published.

env.description: Deliver the secret as this environment variable. Use env or file, not both.
env.x-constraint: Uppercase letters, digits and underscores; does not start with a digit.

file.description: Deliver the secret as a read-only file with this name under /run/hermes/admin-secrets/. Use env or file, not both.
